status.label: Review incomplete — fresh Copilot pass needed
status.detail: Fork PR 231 built the changed UI-test projects and has zero unresolved threads, but the fresh Copilot re-request timed out. Draft concerns include documentation, exception cleanup, test coverage, AMD support, and UIA accessibility.

proposed_comments.title: Fix broken Sandbox documentation
proposed_comments.body: The Sandbox documentation path and instructions do not match the implementation. Please update the documented setup and verification steps.

proposed_comments.title: Clean up certificates on exception paths
proposed_comments.body: Ensure temporary certificates are removed when setup fails partway through so retries do not inherit stale credentials.

proposed_comments.title: Cover AltWindowCycle in the test scope
proposed_comments.body: The test filters do not cover the AltWindowCycle path introduced by this change. Add the missing project or narrow the stated coverage.

proposed_comments.title: Correct the test filters
proposed_comments.body: The current filters imply broader coverage than the selected test projects actually provide. Align the filters and documentation with the executed tests.

proposed_comments.title: Handle AMD svm capability
proposed_comments.body: Please confirm the AMD svm capability is handled consistently with the supported virtualization configurations.

proposed_comments.title: Avoid UIA accessibility pollution
proposed_comments.body: Ensure the new UI elements do not add unintended UI Automation nodes or duplicate accessible content.
